name: bolchall-v2
description: Bolchall V2 — hackathon-grade home-based speech therapy SaaS

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter web dev" "pnpm --filter api dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter api build && pnpm --filter web build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter web lint && pnpm --filter api lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter web typecheck && pnpm --filter api typecheck
